name: ruler-time-picker
summary: Drag a tick ruler and the big time or date rolls piece by piece with a motion blur.
props: One tick per `step` minutes, or one tick per day with the 1st of each month marked.
Controlled value: a 24-hour time, or a Date in date mode (its time of day is kept).
Called on every tick the ruler passes, while you drag.
Small line above the value, e.g. 'Reminder time:'.
Time: 12-hour clock with a rolling am / pm (tap it to jump 12 hours); false for 00–23.
Date: earliest / latest pickable day; the ruler resists past them.
Date: 'auto' shows the year only when it isn't this year.
Date: weekday and month names (Intl), English where Intl isn't available.
A light tap on every step, a firmer one on each whole hour (time) or new month (date).
A soft tick on every step, generated in code (no audio file); it plays alongside other audio.
The big value text (colour, weight, font family).
behavior: Drag sideways anywhere on the picker to scrub; fling to coast. It snaps to the nearest step when it stops. A touch during a fling catches it. In date mode, past minDate / maxDate the ruler follows at a fraction of your finger and springs back. Every step taps (firmer on the hour or a new month) and ticks softly. Tap am / pm to jump 12 hours.

Ticks (and month markers) slide, swell and fade on the native driver from one endless pool. Each piece that changes rolls up (later) or down (earlier) with ghosted copies for a motion blur. Reduce Motion swaps the roll for an instant change.
One adjustable element whose value is the spoken time or full date; increment / decrement move one step, within the limits. In 12-hour time a custom action switches to the other half of the day.
